# Network features

Only commands of side-effect class X1 (egress), I1 (simulator I/O) and D1 (device I/O) may open network sockets (CONSTITUTION section 3.1, CORE.BUS.POL.EGRESS). This list is generated from the registry manifest and the settings manifest, and names every such command.

Every X1 command is off by default: its opt-in setting below defaults to off (`false`, `off`, `disabled` or an empty list), and generation fails otherwise.

I1 and D1 commands reach only the simulators and devices that have been configured, and run only on explicit user action.

| Command | Class | CLI | Domain | Phase | Opt-in setting | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device.connect@1` | D1 | `fid device connect` | device | P2 | n/a | n/a |
| `egress.send@1` | X1 | `fid egress send` | egress | P0 | `egress.destinations` | `[]` |
| `update.check@1` | X1 | `fid update check` | update | P1a | `update.consent` | `"off"` |

3 commands.
